steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: *sign* There's no end to it.
Lisa and McQueen hide behind a stone pillar, not daring to venture in. Another group of shadows blocks the road, and this time, even Lisa can sense how powerful they are.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: It seems that we are also trapped, like in the stories. As long as there is a source of fear, the monsters will keep popping up.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Think about how we can eliminate the source if you have time to blabber. Who is this person, and what are their fears...?
Lisa peeks at the shadows winding closer to the stone pillar, feeling an inexplicable familiarity.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Do you remember the forgery exhibited at the Belphegor in N.F. 107...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Impressive, Miss Lisa. You're still in the mood to talk about art history now.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: This is not small talk, don't interrupt!

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: The painting is called <color=#fb9259>Judy on the Blue Couch</color> and depicts a heroine named Judy from ancient legends ending her own life in disgrace on a blue couch.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I've heard about it, too. It claimed to be an ancient original found in the underground of DisCity, but actually, it's just a poorly restored forgery based on historical data...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: On the contrary, I think the forgery is not only superior to the original but even has more artistic value.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Hmm? ...The forgery is more valuable?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Don't get me wrong. I'm not trying to praise the commercial practice of falsification. It's just that... rather than the original work, which truthfully illustrates the legend, the forgery gives me more of a sense of the soul from the creator.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Ignoring the traces left to make the painting look old, the artist's use of crimson scarlet and sapphire blue is even more dramatic and bold. The contrast is intense and highly saturated, making Judy's vitality before this moment and her resignation even more vivid.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: As an art agent, you should know very well that having your own expression and thinking, like Enfer, is an irreplaceable asset for DisCity nowadays.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Yes, no one knows better than I do... Unfortunately, the forger failed to replicate Enfer's myth and disappeared as a nobody. The museum later destroyed the forgery as a scandal, so Judy on the Blue Couch no longer exists in the world.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Isn't Judy the source of fear? Then why... does the shadow give me the same feeling as when I first laid eyes on the forgery?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Resigned, humiliated... She seems to want to say something to us.
Lisa peeks out from behind the pillar. McQueen isn't quick enough to pull her back and can only watch as Lisa is drawn by the familiarity.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: How exactly are you connected to the painting? Whose fear are you, and what exactly is this fear?

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Uh... Ah... Give me... my dreams, my ideals back... No... I don't want to paint these...
The shadow squirms and lets out broken howls, but it doesn't seem to have any intention of attacking Lisa.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Dreams? Don't want to paint? What does that mean...?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Their Mania Value is stronger than the previous shadows, and they even have some consciousness, but they are not attacking me.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Probably because they didn't see you as an enemy in the first place, Miss Lisa.
McQueen interrupts Lisa's thoughts with a smile.
She steps out from behind the pillar, looking down at her hands and shaking her head with a bitter smile.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: You are right. One has to eliminate the source of fear. Either destroy the things that inspire negative emotions, or... face and conquer the fear by themselves.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Unfortunately, the painting no longer exists, and I'm just a mediocre agent now. Without the help of other Sinners, I can't defeat my fear.
Just as McQueen shows up, the shadow lunges at her as if suddenly stimulated.
